description: Local diagnostic CLI for NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10). Detects power caps, UMA pressure, thermal risk, CUDA 13/SM_121 wheel mismatches, Docker issues, and validates vLLM/Ollama/llama.cpp/SGLang recipes.
